name: EOD 2026-05-30
body:
> Eod · Alphalete · 2026-05-30

Saturday. Alphalete-focused day on Yoast metadata for the location pages.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Read-only Yoast audit of all 131 location pages (children of parent 5543): duplicate template metas and 4 wrong-city bugs found.
- Standardized all 131 titles to "[Service] in [City], CO | Alphalete".
- Fixed wrong-city bleed (Florissant 12280 and Franktown 12316 showing "Florence"; Rockvale hydro 11452 showing "Ramah"; Green Mountain Falls hydro 10484 truncated), an "Alphalette" typo (6773) and the "Canon City" spelling across 3 pages.
- Rewrote 84 duplicate meta descriptions (20 drain, 27 hydro, 37 trenchless) into unique region-tagged copy.
- Added a FAQPage schema layer to the `alphalete-seo-helpers.php` mu-plugin (v1.2.0 to v1.3.0) with an `_alphalete_faqs_cache` override, mirroring Summit's pattern.
- Backed up before every change, purged LiteSpeed, verified live. Overpromising draft claims (PSI, "lasts 50 years", "more affordable") were stripped.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- No work. Carry-overs from 5/28 remain: 8 draft pages to publish, a Chandler sewer title typo, H1 issues, 5 phone-href typos, a broken href. GHL DNI number left alone (intentional tracking).

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- No work. Location-page optimization not started; Metasync `otto-dynamic-indexing-module` flagged, untouched.

# Follow-ups
- Alphalete FAQ schema is dormant until `_alphalete_faqs_cache` is populated per page to match visible FAQs.
- mu-plugin v1.3.0 updated locally only, not deployed.
- Summit carry-overs above still open.
